Providence Bike Jam

Providence, RI · Social

Providence Bike Jam is a social group ride in Providence, RI. Schedule: Once a month on a Friday night; details posted on Instagram the day before, from Varies (Burnside Park and India Point Park are common).

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @pvdbikejam the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Providence Bike Jam group ride

A monthly Friday night bike party. Themed rides, dance-party stops, a pace around 10 mph. The start location changes; it's posted on Instagram at least a day ahead.
